newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Program cutbacks lift Australian jobless - govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Program cutbacks lift Australian jobless - govt.

text.p: The Australian government said on Wednesday training program reductions were responsible for the recent increase in the number of long-term unemployed.

"The reason we've seen the long-term unemployed figures rise in the latest figures is because the merry-go-round of long-term training programs, which brought eight out of 10 back onto the unemployment queues, has been halted," Vocational Education and Training Minister David Kemp told parliament.
The Australian Bureau of Statistics, when compiling its monthly labour force figures, does not define people involved in training programs as unemployed.
